model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five datasets (NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, HQA) under two conditions: with and without context, comparing three models—Standard, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical axis represents average performance, ranging from 0 to 60, while the horizontal axis displays the two conditions: "With Context" and "Without Context." For the "With Context" condition, the Standard model (blue bar with circle pattern) achieves a performance of approximately 58, while CInGS (w/) (solid blue) reaches about 60. In the "Without Context" condition, the Standard model (purple bar) scores around 46, and CInGS (w/) (solid purple) achieves approximately 48. The CInGS model (w/) shows a higher performance than the Standard model in both conditions, and performance is consistently higher when context is provided. The legend indicates that "w/" denotes the CInGS model with context, and "CInGS" refers to the model without context.
